shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台前，身旁浮着一个DNA双螺旋和细菌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab bench beside a floating DNA double helix icon and a bacterium icon, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 改造过基因的细菌，能帮忙治污。
overlay: 工程菌治污：本事大，规矩更大

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣指向一个细菌图标和一个盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a bacterium icon and a shield icon side by side.
shots.narration: 今天讲它的本事，也讲它的规矩。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰在组会上兴奋地展示一张空白示意图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student excitedly presents a blank diagram at a group meeting.
shots.narration: 阿杰读到工程菌治污，很兴奋。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰比划着把一个菌瓶倒进河里的想象气泡
shots.prompt_en: A thought bubble above the young male student shows him pouring a flask into a river.
shots.narration: 他说：做出来，直接倒进污染河里！

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 老周摆手，王老师在旁边摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man raises his hand to stop him, and the safety administrator shakes her head beside him.
shots.narration: 老周和王老师同时说：不行。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 为什么不行？先看工程菌能做什么。

shots.section_title: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
shots.scene: 一个细菌图标里，一段DNA被剪刀剪开换上新片段
shots.prompt_en: Inside a bacterium icon, a piece of DNA is snipped by small scissors and a new colored segment is inserted. No people.
shots.narration: 科学家改造细菌的基因，
overlay: 改造细菌，清理危险废物

shots.section_title: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
shots.scene: 改造后的细菌朝一堆带骷髅象形图的废物桶前进
shots.prompt_en: The modified bacteria move toward a pile of waste drums with skull pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 让它们专门对付危险废物。

shots.section_title: 改造细菌，清理危险废物
shots.scene: 三个空白方框依次出现：剪刀、盾牌、灯泡图标
shots.prompt_en: Three blank boxes appear one by one with icons: scissors, a shield, and a light bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 主要往三个方向改。

shots.section_title: 多产降解酶，分解更快
shots.scene: 细菌内部的小工厂图标加速运转，冒出很多酶图标
shots.prompt_en: A tiny factory icon inside a bacterium speeds up and releases many small enzyme icons. No people.
shots.narration: 一是让它多产降解酶，

shots.section_title: 多产降解酶，分解更快
shots.scene: 污染物分子被大量酶图标快速剪碎，旁边一个快进的时钟
shots.prompt_en: Pollutant molecules are quickly cut apart by many enzyme icons, with a fast-forward clock beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 污染物分解得更快。

shots.section_title: 耐得住高浓度毒物
shots.scene: 普通细菌在深色毒物液体中萎缩
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary bacterium shrinks and fades in a dark toxic liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 二是让它耐得住毒。

shots.section_title: 耐得住高浓度毒物
shots.scene: 工程菌在同样的深色液体中依旧精神，外围有盾牌
shots.prompt_en: An engineered bacterium with a small shield around it stays healthy in the same dark toxic liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 毒物浓度高，也能活下来干活。

shots.section_title: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信
shots.scene: 细菌图标遇到污染物分子，身上亮起一盏小灯
shots.prompt_en: A bacterium icon touches a pollutant molecule and a small light switches on inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 三是把它变成生物传感器，
overlay: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信

shots.section_title: 当生物传感器：发现污染就报信
shots.scene: 一管水样里亮起点点光，旁边一个铃铛图标
shots.prompt_en: A tube of water sample glows with small dots of light, a bell icon ringing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 一碰到污染物，就发出信号。

shots.section_title: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
shots.scene: 试管里一团细菌，旁边一个带骷髅象形图的小瓶
shots.prompt_en: A test tube of bacteria next to a small vial with a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 举个例子：工程大肠杆菌，
overlay: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌

shots.section_title: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
shots.scene: 试管在暗处发出绿色荧光
shots.prompt_en: The test tube glows with green fluorescence in a dark room. No people.
shots.narration: 水里有砷，它就发出荧光。

shots.section_title: 例子：遇砷发光的工程大肠杆菌
shots.scene: 两支试管对比：一支发光一支不发光
shots.prompt_en: Two test tubes side by side: one glowing green, one dark. No people.
shots.narration: 一看亮不亮，就知道有没有砷。

shots.section_title: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管
shots.scene: 一个放大镜照着一株工程菌，旁边三个警示图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass over an engineered bacterium, with three warning icons nearby. No people.
shots.narration: 但工程菌也有风险。
overlay: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管

shots.section_title: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管
shots.scene: 工程菌进入河流，与当地小生物混在一起，打问号
shots.prompt_en: Engineered bacteria drift into a river and mix with local tiny creatures, with question marks above them. No people.
shots.narration: 放到野外，可能打乱原有的生态。

shots.section_title: 工程菌的风险：生态、伦理与监管
shots.scene: 盾牌和天平图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a balance scale icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 所以必须考虑伦理，接受监管。

shots.section_title: 转基因微生物：依法分级管理
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白封面的法规书，封面只有DNA图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a law book with a blank cover showing only a DNA icon.
shots.narration: 在我国，转基因微生物要依法管理。
overlay: 转基因微生物：依法分级管理

shots.section_title: 转基因微生物：依法分级管理
shots.scene: 四级台阶，每级一个盾牌，从浅到深
shots.prompt_en: Four steps like a staircase, each with a shield that gets darker from bottom to top. No people.
shots.narration: 农业用的，按转基因生物条例分级管。

shots.section_title: 转基因微生物：依法分级管理
shots.scene: 王老师和老周在空白申请表上讨论，旁边公章图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man discuss a blank application form with an official stamp icon nearby.
shots.narration: 先做安全评价，再按规定报告、审批。

shots.section_title: 转基因微生物：依法分级管理
shots.scene: 单位生物安全委员会的圆桌会议
shots.prompt_en: Several people sit around a round table reviewing blank documents, the older man and the safety administrator among them.
shots.narration: 实验方案，还要过单位生物安全委员会。

shots.section_title: 未经批准，工程菌不进环境
shots.scene: 菌瓶倒进河里的图标被打上大红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a flask being poured into a river, crossed out with a big red X. No people.
shots.narration: 清理污染场地，就是把菌放进环境。
overlay: 未经批准，工程菌不进环境

shots.section_title: 未经批准，工程菌不进环境
shots.scene: 实验室门口，菌瓶被挡在门内，门上有锁
shots.prompt_en: At the lab door, a flask is stopped inside by a closed door with a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 未经批准，一律不得环境释放。

shots.section_title: 未经批准，工程菌不进环境
shots.scene: 台阶图标：实验室、中间试验、环境释放，最后一级有审批印章
shots.prompt_en: A staircase of three steps with icons: a lab, a small greenhouse, an open field; an approval stamp icon hangs over the last step. No people.
shots.narration: 试验要一步步来，每步按规定办。

shots.section_title: 未经批准，工程菌不进环境
shots.scene: 阿杰点头，把想象气泡里的河流划掉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods and crosses out the river in his thought bubble.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：想法再好，也要守法。

shots.section_title: 工程菌废物：灭活后再出实验室
shots.scene: 工程菌培养瓶旁的普通垃圾桶和水槽被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Beside a flask of engineered bacteria, an ordinary trash bin and a sink drain are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 工程菌的培养物不能随手倒。
overlay: 工程菌废物：灭活后再出实验室

shots.section_title: 工程菌废物：灭活后再出实验室
shots.scene: 小研把废液和耗材放进带生物危害标志的容器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places used culture liquid and tips into a container with a biohazard warning sign.
shots.narration: 废液、耗材收进专用容器，

shots.section_title: 工程菌废物：灭活后再出实验室
shots.scene: 老李把容器送进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer loads the container into an autoclave and closes the door.
shots.narration: 先灭活，再按规定处置。

shots.section_title: 工程菌废物：灭活后再出实验室
shots.scene: 冰箱里的菌种管排列整齐，旁边一本登记本
shots.prompt_en: Strain tubes lined up in a lab freezer box, a blank logbook beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 保存的菌株登记清楚，不带出实验室。

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品：按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 带骷髅象形图的小瓶放进上锁的柜子
shots.prompt_en: A small vial with a skull pictogram placed into a locked cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 传感器要测砷，砷是剧毒。
overlay: 含砷样品和标准品：按剧毒品管

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品：按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 两个人一起开柜，在登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the older man open a locked cabinet together and sign a blank logbook.
shots.narration: 含砷标准品专人专管，领用登记。

shots.section_title: 含砷样品和标准品：按剧毒品管
shots.scene: 含砷废液收进单独的带骷髅象形图的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Waste liquid goes into a separate waste container with a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 含砷废液单独收集，交学校处置。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在三个图标前：酶、盾牌、发光灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three icons: an enzyme, a shield and a glowing light bulb.
shots.narration: 一起回顾一下。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 发光的试管
shots.prompt_en: A test tube glowing green in the dark. No people.
shots.narration: 工程菌还能当传感器，遇砷发光。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 盾牌、天平和打叉的河流图标
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon, a balance scale icon and a crossed-out river icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 依法分级管理，未经批准不进环境。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 高压灭菌器和上锁柜子图标
shots.prompt_en: An autoclave icon and a locked cabinet icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 废物先灭活，含砷物品专管。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、小研一起挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 科技向善，依法创新，下次见！
